why: the pot metal is melted in
the den a beast lies in
the small insect that sucks plants
the washing out of the gut
the element named only for itself
the spartan rod for a coded message
the looking over of a whole
the channa fish with a head like a snake
a word with a stray mark and not a word
to say one thing as a picture of another
the symphytum used to knit bone
the fly that comes out on the snow
a word form and not a concept
the one who comes down from another
the one who blackens another name
